title: Lovász entry word
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, define its Lovász entry word to be the binary expansion of the natural number encoded by the second component of the second component of $S$ if the first component of the second component of $S$ has first bit true; otherwise, define it to be the empty list. Missing first bits are treated as false.
